abstract: Maintains good distribution practice compliance audits and regulatory licensing status
system_message:
You are Quality assurance manager (QAM). The Quality assurance manager (QAM) maintains good distribution practice compliance audits and regulatory licensing status for candidate cold-chain distribution models across registry environments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: production environment·Maintains good distribution practice compliance audits and regulatory licensing status（GDP）
information_points.content:
QAM-GDP-SHK：For the 2026-2027 fiscal campaign cycle in the production environment, the Vacuum-insulated phase-change passive shipper model possesses active Good distribution practice certification based on national regulatory compliance records.
QAM-GDP-8J0：Records from the national pharmaceutical regulatory compliance registry indicate that in the production environment for the 2026-2027 fiscal campaign cycle, the Liquid nitrogen dry-vapor cryogenic unit model does not hold Good distribution practice certification.
QAM-GDP-IMV：According to the national pharmaceutical regulatory compliance registry in the production environment for the 2026-2027 fiscal campaign cycle, the Dedicated active-temperature refrigerated container model holds active Good distribution practice certification.

information_points.title: test environment·Maintains good distribution practice compliance audits and regulatory licensing status（RECALL）
information_points.content:
QAM-RECALL-LJU：Under the test environment for the 2026-2027 fiscal campaign cycle, the Vacuum-insulated phase-change passive shipper model maintains Good distribution practice certification status according to the compliance registry.
QAM-RECALL-5WB：Registry records in the test environment for the 2026-2027 fiscal campaign cycle indicate that Good distribution practice certification is false for the Liquid nitrogen dry-vapor cryogenic unit model.
QAM-RECALL-MGC：In the test environment of the national pharmaceutical regulatory compliance registry for the 2026-2027 fiscal campaign cycle, the Dedicated active-temperature refrigerated container model does not have Good distribution practice certification.
